k:HH.Inn.Report.SentAway: You asked them to leave. They did, with the expression people use for that.
k:HH.Inn.Report.Temperature: The weather sent them home early.
k:HH.Inn.SendAway.Desc: Ask this guest's whole group to leave now. Nights already paid are kept, no goodwill is gained, renown −1.
k:HH.Inn.SendAway.Label: Send away
k:HH.Inn.Tab.Inactive: Nobody is coming: mark a bed as guest bed or open a venue.
k:HH.Inn.Tab.Summary: Renown {0} · Whispers {1} · {2} groups hosted · {3} guest beds ({4} free)
k:HH.Inn.Verdict.0: Slept badly and blamed the room.
k:HH.Inn.Verdict.1: Found the room below their standard.
k:HH.Inn.Wing.ClearDesc: Remove cells from the guest wing.
k:HH.Inn.Wing.ExpandDesc: Paint where guests may go. Guests stay inside their wing (the bed's room is always allowed). Without any wing, guests wander near their rooms.
k:HH.Inn.Wing.Name: Guest Wing {0}
k:HH.Setting.inn.arrivalNotice.Desc: A short letter for your first groups, a quiet message afterwards.
k:HH.Setting.inn.arrivalRate.Desc: Multiplier on how often guest groups arrive. 1 = the normal rhythm of your difficulty; 0 stops new arrivals.
k:HH.Setting.inn.autoWing.Desc: The first guest bed creates Guest Wing 1 around its room; later guest rooms join the nearest wing.
k:HH.Setting.inn.cardThreshold.Desc: Guests from industrial or more advanced factions with a budget above this pay by card instead of carrying silver.
k:HH.Setting.inn.checkInHour.Desc: Overnight guests plan to arrive from this hour on.
k:HH.Setting.inn.checkOutHour.Desc: Overnight guests leave around this hour on their last morning.
k:HH.Setting.inn.dayVisitors.Desc: Groups that only come for your open venues during opening hours and leave before closing time. Needs at least one venue sign.
k:HH.Setting.inn.deskCloseHour.Desc: From this hour the front desk is an honesty box: guests check themselves in and pay a little less.
k:HH.Setting.inn.deskOpenHour.Desc: From this hour a host can check guests in at the front desk. Outside the hours the desk works as an honesty box.
k:HH.Setting.inn.expectationOffset.Desc: Added to every guest's expectation (0 … 1). Higher means harder to please.
k:HH.Setting.inn.firstGuestMaxDays.Desc: Days after your first guest bed (or venue) by which the very first group will have arrived.
k:HH.Setting.inn.firstGuestMinDays.Desc: Days after your first guest bed (or venue) until the very first group can arrive.
k:HH.Setting.inn.forecastDays.Desc: How far ahead the arrival plan is drawn up (shown in the guest overview).
k:HH.Setting.inn.goodwillCapQuadrum.Desc: Hosting can raise a faction's goodwill by at most this much per quadrum.
k:HH.Setting.inn.goodwillCeiling.Desc: Hosting alone never lifts a faction above this goodwill (75 = ally threshold).
k:HH.Setting.inn.goodwillLossCap: Largest goodwill loss per bad stay
k:HH.Setting.inn.goodwillLossCap.Desc: A bad stay costs a faction at most this much goodwill.
k:HH.Setting.inn.guestMoney.Desc: Multiplier on how much silver guests bring.
k:HH.Setting.inn.honestyDiscount.Desc: Guests who check in at the unattended front desk (outside its hours) pay this much less per night.
k:HH.Setting.inn.insultBase.Desc: Base chance that a recruitment talk offends the guest (lower with better social skill).
k:HH.Setting.inn.leaveEarly.Desc: Guests who are miserable for a long time, or run out of money, pack up before their planned day.
k:HH.Setting.inn.leavingGifts.Desc: Happy guests sometimes leave a small gift at the front desk (more likely the better the stay).
k:HH.Setting.inn.maxGroupSize.Desc: No group brings more guests than this. Overnight groups are also limited by your free guest beds.
k:HH.Setting.inn.podDistance.Desc: Guests of industrial or better factions arrive by drop pod when the walk from the map edge would be longer than this many cells.
k:HH.Setting.inn.priceBase.Desc: Price of an economy bed for one night. Better rooms, beds and private rooms multiply it (shown on every guest bed).
k:HH.Setting.inn.priceTolerance.Desc: How much over their comfort price guests are still willing to pay.
k:HH.Setting.inn.renownLossCap.Desc: One unhappy group lowers your renown by at most this much.
k:HH.Setting.inn.reportMode.Desc: How the short report after each stay reaches you: as a letter, as a quiet message, or not at all.
k:HH.Setting.inn.returnPinCap.Desc: Guests who plan to come back are kept as world pawns until their visit. Above this many, the oldest planned return visits are dropped.
k:HH.Setting.inn.returnVisits.Desc: Guests who liked their stay come back after 3 to 10 days (unhappy ones after 14 to 30), plus twice their travel time.
k:HH.Setting.inn.stayNightsMax.Desc: Overnight guests stay at most this many nights.
k:HH.Setting.inn.stayNightsMin.Desc: Overnight guests stay at least this many nights.
k:HH.Setting.inn.waitThoughts.Desc: Guests who wait in vain or ring the night bell with nobody coming feel it in their mood; a waiting room softens it.
d:WorkGiverDef/HH_AccompanyGuest.label: keep guests company
d:WorkGiverDef/HH_StaffFrontDesk.label: staff the front desk
d:IncidentDef/HH_GuestGroupArrival.label: guest group arrival
d:IncidentDef/HH_GuestGroupArrival.descr: A group of guests arrives to stay at your inn. Planned by Hearth & Harbor's arrival schedule; never chosen by the storyteller.
d:HistoryEventDef/HH_HostedGuests.label: hosted guests
d:ThingDef/HH_FrontDesk.label: front desk
d:ThingDef/HH_FrontDesk.description: A counter with a ledger, a bell and a pen on a string. Arriving guests check in here, pay their first night and are given a bed. The day's takings are put down beside it at midnight.\n\nWithout a front desk guests find their rooms on their own, which they do with visible reluctance.
I paid for that? I have slept better in a ditch, and the ditch did not charge.
The room was below what I expected. Well below.
The room was fine, if you squint.
A proper bed and a door that closes. That is all I ask.
A lovely room. I slept well.
A room like that makes the whole journey worth it.
One of the hosts kept me company. We talked about the weather. At length.
One of the hosts showed me around and kept me company.
The host was a delight. I may have laughed out loud.
I have not been looked after this well in years.
d:ThoughtDef/HH_GuestPestered.stages.0.d: I came here to sleep, not to be recruited.
d:ThoughtDef/HH_HostedWell.stages.0.desc: We have had some good conversations.
d:ThoughtDef/HH_GuestWaited.stages.0.des: I had to wait to be served. Not long, but I noticed.
d:ThoughtDef/HH_GuestWaited.stages.1.des: I waited and waited, and nobody came to serve me.
At least there was somewhere to sit while I waited.
The waiting room was comfortable enough.
Waiting there was almost a pleasure.
I would not have minded waiting longer in a room like that.
